page.layout: One centred title page, one column. From top to bottom: the title in large capitals (DAVIDIS / DERODONIS / PHILOSOPHIA), then CONTRACTA in spaced italic capitals, then two italic lines of edition statement, then a woodcut vignette (tree with banderole and clouds, a monogram medallion beside it), then the place and printer in italic and roman, a rule, and the date in capitals. A library stamp at lower right and a digitiser's credit at the bottom right are not transcribed.
page.notes: The engraving shows a tree between two clouds with arms holding a banderole; the banderole lettering is only partly legible, so "SINE TE NIHIL" is a reading of the visible letters and is marked [?]. A monogram medallion stands to the right of the tree. The handwritten "2" at top right, the library stamp at lower right and the digitiser's credit are not printed text and are left out.
